name: Dallas & Fort Worth
summary: The Metroplex — Dallas's gleaming arts district and the site of the Kennedy assassination, and Fort Worth's genuine cowtown with a twice-daily cattle drive and a jewel-box art museum.

lodging.name: A downtown Dallas or Fort Worth hotel
lodging.blurb: Dallas for the Arts District; Fort Worth for the Stockyards.

foodMustTry.name: Texas brisket & a chicken-fried steak
foodMustTry.blurb: Barbecue and the state's cream-gravy classic.

days.label: Day 321 — Dallas & Dealey Plaza
days.summary: The city and a national tragedy.

item.title: The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza
item.blurb: The perch from which JFK was shot in 1963, now a careful museum of the assassination and its aftermath.

item.title: Dallas Arts District
item.blurb: The largest arts district in the country — the Nasher Sculpture Center and the Dallas Museum of Art.

item.title: Fort Worth Stockyards & cattle drive

location.name: Fort Worth Stockyards
location.address: 131 E Exchange Ave, Fort Worth, TX

item.blurb: A twice-daily Longhorn cattle drive down brick streets, plus honky-tonks and Billy Bob's.

item.title: The Kimbell Art Museum

location.name: Kimbell Art Museum
location.address: 3333 Camp Bowie Blvd, Fort Worth, TX

item.blurb: A small, perfect collection in a Louis Kahn masterpiece — one of the finest art buildings in America.
